contact_policy.meaning: Conservative geometry triage heuristics, not proof of chemical stability. Framework bond identity is retained, lengths are checked relative to the parent and stay unchanged in rigid scans; short C-Ti bonds are never rejected by a universal cutoff.

duplicate_policy.match: same persistent ID set and element for each ID; compare minimum-image contact geometry and align candidate/reference by mean framework translation
duplicate_policy.exact: same cell <=1e-8 A, same PBC, max ID coordinate displacement <=1e-6 A
duplicate_policy.near: same cell/PBC, Ag RMS <=0.15 A, framework RMS <=0.15 A, framework max <=0.25 A with numerical 1e-8 A tolerance; other-PBC coordinate matches separately flagged
duplicate_policy.limitations: No rotation or relabeling equivalence is asserted; comparisons with absent/different IDs are not claimed independent by morphology. All proposals share training parent motif lineage.
